ptBR.note: Brazil often drops de after precisar before an infinitive (preciso ir) and puts the pronoun first: eu me lembro de, ele se queixa de.

tandemSoGehts: Cut the cards in the middle. Partner A takes the left half, Partner B takes the right half.
A builds question 1 from the tiles and asks it: “Com o que é que sonhas?” (Put the verb in the right form.)

B hears the question and builds the answer. Put the blue verb in the right form (sonhar → sonho) and choose the one preposition that goes with it from the tile: pensar em, sonhar com, depender de, lembrar-se de, contar com. Before o, a, os, as the preposition merges with the article: em + as = nas, de + a = da. Learn the verb and the preposition together. A tile in brackets such as (eu) says who is meant; you don't write it.
Then B asks question 2 and A answers. Take turns. At the end, check with the answer sheet.
Last, swap cards and do it all again, faster.
